adminDevPlatform.title: Dev Platform
adminDevPlatform.intro: Repositories, dev jobs, and pull-request pipelines run by omadia agents. Jobs run isolated and always end in a pull request for human review — omadia never merges.

apps.createBody: A GitHub App gives the dev platform short-lived, per-repository tokens that cannot merge — the strongest credential mode. Creating one sends you to GitHub to approve the manifest, then brings you back.
apps.orgHelp: Leave empty to create the App under your personal account. Set an organization to create it there instead.
apps.createError: The App setup could not be started. Try again.
apps.unauthorized: you need operator access for the dev platform.
apps.empty: No GitHub Apps yet. Create one to bind repositories with scoped tokens.

gates.advisoryBody: Approving a plan only lets the job start implementing. The authoritative safety check is the diff gate, which reviews the actual patch before any pull request. omadia never merges.
gates.unauthorized: you need operator access for the dev platform.
gates.empty: No plans are waiting for approval.
gates.planLoadError: The plan could not be loaded.
gates.notHolder: You are not authorized to resolve this gate. Its holder role has moved to someone else.
gates.alreadyResolved: This gate is no longer pending — it was resolved or expired. The list has been refreshed.
gates.resolveError: The gate could not be resolved. Try again.

bindApp.intro: Bind this repository to a GitHub App installation. The App issues scoped, short-lived tokens that cannot merge. omadia verifies the installation covers this repository before saving.
bindApp.noApps: No GitHub Apps yet. Create one from the GitHub Apps tab first.
bindApp.installationHelp: Install the App on this repository, then paste the installation ID GitHub shows after install.
bindApp.bound: GitHub App bound. Scoped tokens are now used for this repository.

errors.notCovering: That installation does not cover this repository. Install the App on this repository, then use its installation ID.
errors.unknownInstallation: That installation is not registered. Complete the App install so omadia records it, then try again.
errors.invalidInstallation: Enter the installation ID GitHub showed after installing the App.
errors.appUnusable: The App backing this installation is unusable — its credentials are missing. Re-create the App.
errors.generic: The GitHub App could not be bound. Try again.

adminDevPlatform.unauthorized: you need operator access for the dev platform.

empty.heading: No repositories yet
empty.body: the dev platform runs isolated jobs against your repositories: analyze an issue, plan, implement, and open a pull request for human review. omadia never merges — that stays with you.

remove.title: Remove repository?
remove.body: Running jobs are cancelled first. The stored credential for this repository is deleted from the vault.

protection.warning: Without branch protection your token could push to the default branch directly. The no-merge guarantee depends on it.

jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Start one from a repository row.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel job?
cancelConfirm.body: The runner is terminated. The branch, the log, and any uploaded diff are kept.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete job?
deleteConfirm.body: The job, its log, and its artifacts are removed permanently. Any branch or PR it created is kept.

newJob.title: New job for {repo}
newJob.noIssues: No open issues found for this repository.
newJob.error: The job could not be created.

wizard.title: Add repository
wizard.intro: Connect a repository so the dev platform can run isolated jobs against it and open pull requests for your review.

error.submit: The repository could not be added. Check the owner, name, and credential, then try again.

done.heading: Repository added
done.body: {repo} is connected. You can start a job from the repository list.

githubApp.title: GitHub App — recommended
githubApp.body: Per-repository installation, short-lived scoped tokens, commits as omadia-dev[bot]. The token cannot merge — structurally.

deviceFlow.title: Device flow — quick start
deviceFlow.body: Sign in with your GitHub account through a one-time device code. The fastest way to try the dev platform.

deviceTradeoffs.heading: What this mode means
deviceTradeoffs.asUser: commits appear as your GitHub user, not a bot
deviceTradeoffs.repoWide: the token grants access to all your repositories, not just this one
deviceTradeoffs.canMerge: the token can merge — the no-merge rule is enforced by omadia policy only, not by token scope
deviceTradeoffs.noWebhooks: webhook triggers stay disabled for this repository

pat.title: Fine-grained PAT / deploy key
pat.body: Paste a fine-grained personal access token scoped to this repository. Also the path for GitLab and Gitea.
pat.label: Token

checks.label: branch protection on {branch}
checks.warning: without branch protection a device-flow or PAT token could push to {branch} directly. Enable it in the repository settings — the dev platform will only ever push to omadia/job-* branches, but protection makes that structural.
checks.unknownHint: The stored token cannot read the protection settings — classic device-flow tokens usually lack admin read. You can re-check any time.

detail.artifactError: This phase's recorded output could not be loaded.

cancel.title: Cancel job?
cancel.body: The runner is terminated and the branch is kept.

delete.title: Delete job?
delete.body: The job, its log, and its artifacts are removed permanently. Any branch or PR it created is kept.

repoDetail.loadError: This repository could not be loaded.

budget.heading: Budget
budget.help: Cap the spend per job for this repository. Leave empty to use the platform default.
budget.costError: Enter a positive amount, or leave empty for the default.
budget.saveError: The budget could not be saved.

webhook.heading: Webhook triggers
webhook.help: When enabled, applying the trigger label to an issue starts a job — but only for an allow-listed sender. An empty sender list keeps the webhook off.
webhook.sendersEmpty: None — webhook triggers are off until a sender is added.
webhook.saveError: The webhook setting could not be saved.
